title: Duo and the Feather Bold g
slide_intent: Translate a familiar character feature into letterforms because the brand voice should remain recognizable even when the mascot is absent.
strategic_value: Repeating Duo’s feather shape in the lowercase g can connect typography to an existing source of recognition.
demonstration: A two-panel comparison pairs Duo on white with a white g on green; dotted pink circles identify the related feather and terminal.
practical_value: Evaluate whether a custom letterform carries a recognizable feature of an established brand asset.

content_islands.name: Mascot reference
content_islands.spec: Show Duo at left and circle the upper-right feather.

content_islands.name: Letterform comparison
content_islands.spec: Place the large g at right and circle its upper terminal; retain the Duo and Feather bold captions.

reference_purposes.Intent: Johnson Banks explains that the logotype takes inspiration from Duo’s feathery form to express the company’s quirky personality.
reference_purposes.Expression: Matching dotted annotations connect the owl’s feather contour and the g terminal.

ingredient.name: Feather Bold and the Duolingo wordmark
ingredient.application: Compare the owl feather and g terminal as the source illustrates.
ingredient.scope: Historical 2019 case-study evidence. These are observed design relationships, not a license to redraw the mark or a complete type-usage specification.
